name: ISEARCH AI – GEO AutoPILOT
author: ranki.ai

sections.description:
Ranki.ai creates a rolling content strategy and can publish completed articles directly to WordPress.

Features:

  • Dedicated authenticated REST endpoint
  • Create or update posts by slug, limited to posts the plugin itself created
  • Featured image import
  • Categories
  • Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress metadata
  • Draft, pending or published status
  • Connection key regeneration
  • No deletion of published content on uninstall

After activation, open ISEARCH AI (top-level admin menu) and copy the Site URL and Connection key into Ranki.ai.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the isearch-ai-geo-autopilot directory to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open ISEARCH AI (top-level admin menu).
  4. In Ranki.ai, open Destinations > WordPress > Use plugin connection.
  5. Paste the Site URL and Connection key, then test the connection.
sections.faq:
Does uninstalling the plugin delete articles?

No. Articles and images already published remain in WordPress.

Can I regenerate the key?

Yes. Open ISEARCH AI (top-level admin menu) and click Regenerate connection key. Reconnect Ranki.ai afterward.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The connector writes metadata understood by Yoast SEO, Rank Math and SEOPress.
sections.changelog:
1.3.3

  • Rename the public plugin identity to ISEARCH AI – GEO AutoPILOT and align the WordPress.org slug/text domain with isearch-ai-geo-autopilot.
  • Keep the existing Ranki.ai REST connection namespace for publishing compatibility.

1.3.2

  • Rename the plugin to GoRank GEO AutoPilot and align the WordPress.org slug/text domain with gorank-geo-autopilot.
  • Keep the existing Ranki.ai REST connection namespace for publishing compatibility.

1.3.1

  • Load admin CSS and JavaScript through the WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Update the contributor username.

1.3.0

  • Ranki.ai brand colours and brand mark on the settings screen.
  • Fixed admin notices being rendered inside the header banner.

1.2.0

  • Moved to its own top-level entry in the admin sidebar instead of being buried under Settings.
  • Redesigned settings screen: branded header, guided 3-step setup, copy buttons and connection status.
  • Built-in troubleshooting section.

1.1.0

  • Only posts created by the plugin can be updated; manually created posts with the same slug are never overwritten.
  • Configurable publishing author (Ranki.ai (top-level admin menu)); posts are no longer created with author 0.
  • Featured image errors are reported in the API response instead of being silently ignored.
  • The featured image is re-imported when the cover URL changes.
  • Payload size limit (2 MB) and Content-Type validation on the REST endpoint.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
